content: ⌊ DRAFT g In case a resource is required by a Substitution Software Cluster , the Software Cluster Connector shall connect this re- quired resource only to provided resources of Software Clusters not being a Substitution Software Cluster . Nevertheless, the matching criteria defined in [SWS_SwCluC_00043] apply.
